description.value:
As an action, you can target a creature you can see within 30 feet and force a Wisdom saving throw against your universal force save DC. On a failure, you can make that creature believe or forget one detail of a conversation, observation, or encounter you witnessed alongside it within the last 10 minutes. Regardless of the outcome, you cannot use this ability on the same creature again until you finish a long rest.

You are also difficult to detect while using the Force: any creature trying to sense your Force use has disadvantage on the check, and a creature actively using sense force or force sight must beat your universal force save DC with a universal forcecasting ability check before it can notice your use of the Force, your alignment, or the strength of your connection to it.
